purpose: bounded independent Holding readout diagnostic, not a formal-model replacement
optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 wd0.001 clip1; fixed final600 only
loss: shared pooled valid-positive weighted BCE; mean valid objects per state then mean batch; root-balanced fixed schedule
normalization: training states only, per input feature dimension; std floor.01
evaluation_order: actual AB validation and C first; D actual descriptive only; saved predicted latents only if a form is reliable in both initializations

reliability_diagnostic_gate.if_fail: Stop prediction attribution for that input form; report failure, no retuning. C_selection descriptive, no selection. D not used in this eligibility gate.

prefix_replacement: If at least one independent form passes the prespecified actual gate: exactly one fixed intervention on all11 complete normal-branch roots, replace after-lift z with saved actual z; predict place then close without another correction. Both mixed/alphaZ, both seeds. Compare Holding after each; empty-close branch omitted because one-step already wrong.
device: CUDA serial, no batch change; performance measured separately from quality
